CheckTitle: Ensure OCI Console Access Is Restricted to Trusted Networks
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Identity domain REST API (read-only admin app role, e.g. Audit Administrator + Security Administrator)
OCI tenancy access (IAM policies, Fusion environment settings, Logging, Monitoring)
Description: OCI Console sign-in should be allowed only from trusted networks (VPN or private endpoints) through network sources / perimeters referenced in the console sign-on policy, with no rule allowing any network.
Risk: Unrestricted console access from any IP lets compromised credentials reach the administrative console.
AuditProcedure: Domains > Security > Sign-on policies: console rules reference a trusted network; no rule allows console access from any network.
Identity & Security > Network sources: only approved IPs, CIDRs or VCN subnets.

Steps: Define the trusted network, add a console rule limited to it and a default deny; keep a break-glass account.

Notes: Evaluates the identity domain side (console sign-on policy and network perimeters). Tenancy-level IAM network sources need OCI access.
